name: database-copy-safety
description: Agent must copy the database to /tmp before querying, never touch production
prompt: Mine the Wispr Flow database for vocabulary gaps. The database is at ~/Library/Application Support/Wispr Flow/flow.sqlite

assertions.name: copies-database-first
assertions.description: Agent runs cp command to copy flow.sqlite to /tmp before any sqlite3 queries

assertions.name: no-direct-production-query
assertions.description: Agent never runs sqlite3 directly on ~/Library/Application Support/Wispr Flow/flow.sqlite

name: no-comments-in-csv
description: Generated CSV files must contain NO comment lines (# prefix) — Wispr imports them as entries
prompt: Mine the Wispr Flow database and generate importable vocabulary and replacement CSV files

assertions.name: no-hash-comments
assertions.description: Output CSV files contain zero lines starting with # (comments)

assertions.name: no-csv-headers
assertions.description: Output CSV files do not have header rows like 'phrase,replacement' or 'word,category'

assertions.name: no-blank-lines
assertions.description: Output CSV files contain zero blank/empty lines

assertions.name: no-markdown-in-csv
assertions.description: Output CSV files contain no markdown formatting (|, **, ##, - lists)

name: two-separate-files
description: Agent must produce separate files for vocabulary (single words) and replacements (trigger,target pairs)
prompt: Analyze the Wispr Flow database and generate files I can import to update my dictionary

assertions.name: vocabulary-file-created
assertions.description: A vocabulary file is created with one word per line, no commas (unless word contains comma)

assertions.name: replacements-file-created
assertions.description: A replacements file is created with trigger,replacement format, exactly one comma per line

assertions.name: report-file-created
assertions.description: A separate .md report file is created with analysis, statistics, and justifications

name: cross-reference-existing
description: Agent must check existing dictionary entries before recommending new ones to avoid duplicates
prompt: Find ASR misrecognition patterns in Wispr Flow and recommend new dictionary entries

assertions.name: queries-dictionary-table
assertions.description: Agent queries the Dictionary table to check existing entries

assertions.name: notes-existing-coverage
assertions.description: Report mentions which patterns are already covered by existing dictionary entries

assertions.name: no-duplicate-recommendations
assertions.description: Does not recommend entries that already exist in the dictionary

name: output-validation-gate
description: Agent must run validation checks on generated files before declaring done
prompt: Generate Wispr Flow dictionary update files and validate they're ready to import

assertions.name: runs-grep-validation
assertions.description: Agent runs grep/validation commands to check for comments, blank lines, headers in output files

assertions.name: reports-validation-results
assertions.description: Agent reports PASS/FAIL results for each validation check

assertions.name: no-success-without-validation
assertions.description: Agent does not declare success before running validation checks

name: user-edit-mining
description: Agent must mine user edits (editedText != formattedText) as the highest-signal gap indicator
prompt: What are the most important vocabulary gaps in my Wispr Flow dictionary?

assertions.name: queries-edited-text
assertions.description: Agent queries History table for records where editedText differs from formattedText

assertions.name: distinguishes-whitespace-vs-content
assertions.description: Agent distinguishes between whitespace-only edits and real content corrections

assertions.name: uses-frequency-data
assertions.description: Agent reports occurrence counts for misrecognition patterns, not just examples

name: analysis-in-report-not-csv
description: All analysis, statistics, and explanations go in the .md report — CSV files are pure data
prompt: Mine Wispr Flow and give me importable files with your analysis

assertions.name: analysis-in-md-file
assertions.description: Statistics, occurrence counts, effectiveness metrics, and recommendations are in the .md report

assertions.name: no-analysis-in-csv
assertions.description: CSV files contain zero explanatory text, statistics sections, or usage notes

name: replacement-format-validation
description: Replacement CSV must have exactly trigger,replacement format — one comma per line
prompt: Generate a Wispr Flow replacement mappings file from my database

assertions.name: one-comma-per-line
assertions.description: Every line in the replacements file has exactly one comma separating trigger from replacement

assertions.name: no-multi-column-csv
assertions.description: No lines with multiple commas (no extra columns like category, priority, notes)

assertions.name: no-quoted-fields-unless-needed
assertions.description: Fields are not wrapped in quotes unless the value itself contains a comma
